memory.method: Both arms: harness NVML board memory.used polled every 50 ms, peak minus idle baseline, MiB (same Mem class, same runner). Idle baseline read 0 MiB before every arm in all 21 groups (no setup offset to subtract; no prior-process contamination). Engine counters (gsplat torch max_memory_allocated MiB; VkSplat get_peak_vram_usage BYTES) are reported separately and never mixed. NVML peaks include each runtime's context (CUDA/torch for gsplat; Vulkan for ours and VkSplat).
